summary: Sprint 1 end-to-end test for DeMaxtore. All 21 backend pytest cases pass (health, auth login/refresh/me/logout, forgot+reset with token reuse/short pwd rules + buyer password restored to Buyer@123, notifications role filtering + mark-one/all + 404). Frontend: 18 of 21 UI assertions pass on first pass. Confirmed: login form + demo quick-fill + wrong-pwd error, RBAC redirects to /unauthorized (buyer→admin, buyer→supplier, supplier→admin, admin→buyer), all 3 workspace placeholder pages render with timeline/next-actions/documents/participants and correct workspace-id, forgot→reset deep-link prefills token, logout clears session + tampered access_token recovers to /login without crash, buyer/supplier/admin sidebars contain expected role-specific items. 1 real UI bug found in NotificationBell that intermittently breaks the next click after using 'View all notifications'.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'View all notifications' (data-testid=notification-view-all) navigates to /notifications but does NOT call setOpen(false) on the Radix DropdownMenu. The bell trigger stays in data-state="open" aria-expanded="true" after navigation, and Radix leaves an invisible overlay on <html> that intercepts pointer events on the next page. Subsequent clicks (user-menu-trigger, login flows, even re-clicking the bell itself) time out with 'html intercepts pointer events'. Reproduces ~consistently in scripted tests. Suggested fix: call setOpen(false) inside the onClick of the 'View all notifications' Link, or wrap the Link in a DropdownMenuItem (Radix auto-closes on item select).

action_items: Fix NotificationBell 'View all notifications' to explicitly close the dropdown before navigation (setOpen(false) onClick, or convert anchor to DropdownMenuItem). This is the only blocking UI bug found.
Optional: also call setOpen(false) inside mark-all and item-row click handlers to prevent any leftover Radix overlay state when the user interacts then navigates.

rca of the issue: RCA for NotificationBell bug: NotificationBell uses Radix <DropdownMenu open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>. The 'View all notifications' link is a plain react-router <Link> inside DropdownMenuContent, NOT a DropdownMenuItem. Radix auto-closes only on item-select events. When user clicks the Link, react-router navigates to /notifications, NotificationBell may unmount, but Radix's portal/overlay element may persist briefly with pointer-events disabling. Even after remount on the new page, the trigger button shows data-state=open/aria-expanded=true, confirming that the open state was never reset. Mitigation: call setOpen(false) in onClick of the link, OR add Radix's DropdownMenuItem wrapper which auto-closes on select.
